title_en: Is It Permissible to Accept Isolated Reports (Akhbar al-Ahad) in Matters of Creed?
description_en: Is It Permissible to Accept Isolated Reports (Akhbar al-Ahad) in Matters of Creed?, an episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An episode discussing whether single-narrator or isolated hadiths (akhbar al-ahad) can be relied upon for matters of theological creed.
